method: Each source's trophy-guide page was fetched directly and searched for all 55 official trophy names; a trophy counts as covered when its name appears on the page. Counts below are computed from those reads, not from the sites' own claims.
notes: All 55 official descriptions appear verbatim in at least 4 of the 7 sources; no two sources disagree on any trophy's name, grade or description text.

The five mystery triggers (44, 45, 49, 50, 51) are the only trophies no source confirms a method for; PowerPyx asserts methods for three of them (44, 45, 50), which four other guides leave unconfirmed.
Meditation spots (18), shooting-range golds (42 across 12 ranges), stunts (250 of 397) and challenges (50 of 80) agree everywhere they are stated.
Six sources call Positive Mental Attitude the only possibly missable trophy; PlanetGTA6 says it cannot tell yet.

sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.note: Full 55-trophy guide and roadmap, published 18 Nov 2026. Gives a specific unlock method for every trophy, including three of the five mystery triggers; marks Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin as currently unknown.

sources.name: GTABase
sources.note: Full 55-trophy list with grades, Gamerscore and hidden flags. Marks 5 requirements unconfirmed; counts 18 meditation spots and 42 shooting-range golds across 12 ranges.

sources.name: OutputLag
sources.note: Full 55-trophy list, 27 visible plus 28 hidden. Lists the five mystery trophies with no confirmed unlock method; stresses manual saves at every chapter because there is no mission replay.

sources.name: SixShore
sources.note: Names 43 of 55: the 12 story trophies are covered by count and chapter only, with no names, under a spoiler policy. Puts the platinum at 200 to 250 hours or more, against PowerPyx's 200.

sources.name: GTA Zone
sources.note: Full 55-trophy list with Gamerscore. Names the five unconfirmed entries and the 18 meditation spots in 10 locations.

sources.name: FullSweep
sources.note: Full 55-trophy list in its own words, story trophies named without requirements. Flags the garage-count clash: the trophy text says 8 purchasable garages, PowerPyx's database lists 12.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.note: Full 55-trophy list with official names and descriptions taken from PSN trackers on 18 Nov 2026. Declines to call any trophy missable yet.
